id: title:Gilbert09:surface app token mismatch as a reconnect prompt

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a specific exception classification and regression test for TikTok Ads OAuth account listing, distinguishing app token mismatches from other API errors.
review.reason: Adds a shared constant for the app token mismatch message, updates OAuth account listing error handling to raise a specific `IntegrationAccountListingError` when the API code is 40000 and the message matches the app token mismatch pattern, and adds regression tests to verify this behavior. This represents a substantive, bounded improvement in the reliability and correctness of the
review.uncertainty: The actual production impact and user benefit are not independently verified; this score relies solely on the implementation and test changes observed in the provided diff.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No missing context. No untrusted instructions. No score assigned yet.

observations.behavior: Adds a new constant TIKTOK_APP_TOKEN_MISMATCH_MESSAGE to the utils module, explicitly defining the message string associated with app token mismatch errors.
observations.code_quote: TIKTOK_APP_TOKEN_MISMATCH_MESSAGE = "app_id is inconsistent with the token's app information"
observations.posthog_connection: Provides a shared, documented constant for identifying the specific app token mismatch error message, supporting the subsequent conditional check in the source module.

observations.behavior: Updates the OAuth account listing error handling to include an additional condition: if the API code is 40000 AND the error message contains the app token mismatch string, it raises an IntegrationAccountListingError instead of the original TikTokAdsAPIError.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes the exception handling behavior for TikTok Ads API errors. Previously, only codes 40105 and 40110 triggered a reconnect message. Now, code 40000 also triggers it, but only if the message matches the app token mismatch pattern. This prevents generic parameter errors with code 40000 from being misclassified as credential errors.

observations.behavior: Adds a new test case that verifies the OAuth account listing raises an IntegrationAccountListingError when the API response indicates an app token mismatch, and another test case that verifies other 40000 errors do not raise that error.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds regression tests to ensure the new exception handling behavior is correct: it raises the reconnect error for the specific app token mismatch case, and does not raise it for other 40000 parameter errors. This protects against false positives in credential rejection.
